stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> NeedsRerun
    NeedsRerun --> Running: run requested
    Green --> Running: run requested
    Red --> Running: run requested
    Running --> Green: latest job run passed
    Running --> Red: latest job run failed
    Green --> NeedsRerun: job command changed
    Green --> NeedsRerun: linked task or design changed
    Red --> NeedsRerun: job command changed
    NeedsRerun --> NeedsRerun: never run or manually marked stale
